scope: INITIAL saved model, stage 0, catalog only; no final-model covariance claim
covariance_display: Cv=diag(v) Cq diag(v); sigma(point)=sqrt(w Cv w). Nodal sigmas are not interpolated.
resolution_display: The saved nodal resolution diagonal is interpolated for display, not redefined as pointwise resolution.
identity_map: Both copied companions retain contributing event/origin/pick/channel/epoch IDs and matrix node order. Each section row saves its eight node indices and basis weights.

artifact_identity_maps.sections.csv.gz: node_0 through node_7 index model_nodes in initial_full_dd_identifiers.json.gz; weight_0 through weight_7 give the full velocity basis. All contributing native observation identities remain in that companion.
artifact_identity_maps.initial_full_dd_resolution.pdf: Rendered from sections.csv.gz; all contributor identities are in initial_full_dd_identifiers.json.gz.
artifact_identity_maps.initial_full_dd_resolution.png: Rendered from sections.csv.gz; all contributor identities are in initial_full_dd_identifiers.json.gz.

noise_assumption: Independent primitive catalog-pick errors; provider symmetric timing uncertainty is assumed to represent one standard deviation, although confidence levels are not supplied. Catalog differences reuse the same constituent errors. This is an uncertainty-scale assumption, not instrument-response calibration. No cross-correlation input.
limitations: Conditional on fixed robust/distance weights, kernel masks, column scales, and computed ray branches.
Source-domain bounds and their active sets are omitted; this is not the covariance of the constrained nonlinear estimator.
Reference catalog origin baselines are held fixed; source-coordinate and origin-time parameters remain jointly coupled in the local estimator.
Excludes correlated station/model errors, selection effects, regularization bias, nonlinear errors, and ray/derivative errors.
No cross-correlation data or independent differential noise are inferred.
Unmasked response uses the computed local ray derivatives and is not a first-arrival accuracy certificate.
variance_roundoff_allowance: 64 binary64 eps times sum of absolute quadratic-form terms; values within this allowance are displayed as zero.
controls: Independent two-variable covariance and tensor-basis midpoint/endpoint checks passed before input reads.
